content:
In celebration of the release of The Proof in the Code, Kevin Hartnett's new book on the development of Lean and Mathlib, there's a two-part online panel series coming up. Everyone is welcome to join; the registration links are below.

The Mathematicians. 2026-06-11T10:00:00-07:00 @Johan Commelin, @Kevin Buzzard, and @Alex Kontorovich join Kevin Hartnett to discuss what it means to formalize mathematics in Lean, and how computer verification is changing the way mathematicians collaborate, build trust, and decide what counts as proof.

The Builders. 2026-06-12T10:00:00-07:00 @Leonardo de Moura, @Sebastian Ullrich, and @Jeremy Avigad join Kevin Hartnett to talk about Lean from the inside: its origins, its design, and where it's headed.

Registration:

  • The Mathematicians
  • The Builders
